build_materials.none_available: No available build material in the native material-selection inventory.
build_materials.inventory_unknown: Native material inventory is not ready or could not be read. Do not treat missing stock as zero.
build_materials.none_currently_available: Material '{0}' is valid for {1}, but none is currently available
build_materials.invalid_material: Material '{0}' is not a valid build material.
build_materials.quantity_scope: Single material slot; requirements for multiple slots are not evaluated.
build_materials.inventory_scope: Native material-selection quantity across worlds with the same parent, after native construction demand; individual fetch reservations and delivery are not evaluated.
build_materials.next_insufficient: Material is compatible, but native stock is insufficient. A blueprint can be queued; acquire more material before completion.
build_materials.next_unknown: Material is compatible; required quantity or native stock is unknown. Do not assume sufficient material.
build_materials.next_not_required: Material stock is not required in free-build mode.
build_materials.next_sufficient: Material is compatible and the native material-selection quantity is sufficient; delivery to this site is not evaluated.
build_materials.retry_with_auto: Retry with material=auto or material={0} if exact material is not required.
build_materials.inspect_candidates: No usable material is currently available; inspect inventory and material candidates before retrying.
build_materials.suggest_inspect: Inspect world_editor /active/resources/inventory.oni or building_control domain=planning action=materials before retrying.
